summary.text: Darin Harbick is a Republican state representative from Oregon House District 12 who took office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Amber Smith as his general-election opponent.

paragraphs.text: Harbick was born in Springfield, Oregon, lives in Blue River, and graduated from McKenzie River High School.
His career includes managing a Safeway grocery store, owning restaurants and grocery stores in Rainbow, Oregon, and starting Harbick's Logging and Hauling Inc.
He has served on the McKenzie School District board, the McKenzie Chamber of Commerce and the Travel Lane board, and has coached girls basketball at the middle school, high school and college levels.
Harbick assumed office on January 13, 2025, and advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.
